rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep and write a unanimous, administrable opinion adopting the conference’s middle rule: § 3583(e) bars using § 3553(a)(2)(A) retribution as an independent basis, while allowing discussion of “seriousness” only when tethered to enumerated factors. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch to sharpen the textual negative-implication point or to emphasize administrability/harmless-error limits.
